load_w2vbert_model: load a pretrained W2VBert model from the fairseq2 model hub by name
create_w2vbert_model: create a new W2VBert model instance from a W2VBertConfig using the model hub
list_w2vbert_models: iterate over all available W2VBert model asset cards using the model hub
get_w2vbert_arch_config: get the architecture configuration for a named W2VBert model architecture
get_w2vbert_model_config: get the model configuration from a W2VBert asset card or model name
